art
藝術
What could make an art exhibition interesting to someone who rarely visits galleries?
Art feels more approachable when I can connect it with everyday experiences. A short explanation of the artist's choices would help me look more closely.
藝術能連到日常經驗，我就比較容易親近。簡短說明作者的選擇，也會讓我想仔細看。
music
音樂
How does the music you choose change with what you are doing?
I choose quiet instrumental music when I need to read. While cooking, I prefer songs I can sing along with.
閱讀時，我會選安靜的演奏音樂。煮飯時，則喜歡可以跟著唱的歌。
song
歌
What makes a song stay in your memory?
A song stays with me when it connects to a particular moment. Hearing it again can bring back the place and people around me.
一首歌和某個時刻連在一起，就特別記得住。再聽到時，當時的人和地方都會浮現。
film
電影
Would you rather watch a film alone or discuss it with someone afterwards?
I enjoy watching a film with someone who likes discussing it afterwards. Different interpretations can make me notice things I missed.
我喜歡和願意事後聊聊的人一起看電影。不同解讀，會讓我注意到自己漏看的地方。
novel
小說
What would make you continue reading a novel with a slow beginning?
I would continue a novel if its characters felt convincing. A slower plot can work when I care about what happens to them.
人物夠真實，我就會繼續讀這本小說。在意他們的遭遇，情節慢一點也沒關係。
poem
詩
How would you choose a poem to read aloud to a small group?
I would choose a poem whose rhythm I enjoyed speaking. I would read it beforehand to understand where the pauses belong.
我會選朗讀節奏自己喜歡的詩。先唸過一次，知道哪裡適合停頓。
story
故事
How would you turn an ordinary event into an interesting story?
I would build the story around one surprising or meaningful moment. Too many unrelated details could hide the point.
我會圍繞一個意外或有意義的時刻講故事。不相關的細節太多，反而看不出重點。
character
角色
What makes a fictional character believable to you?
A believable character has understandable motives and imperfect choices. I do not need to agree with them to understand why they act.
可信的角色，動機要能理解，也會做不完美的選擇。我不必贊同，仍能明白他為什麼那樣做。
plot
情節
Do you enjoy a surprising plot, or do you prefer knowing where a story is going?
I enjoy a surprising plot when the clues make sense afterwards. A twist feels empty if it contradicts everything that came before.
只要回頭看線索說得通，我就喜歡意外的情節。反轉若推翻前面一切，反而讓人失去投入感。
scene
場景
Describe a scene you would use to open a short film about your neighbourhood.
The opening scene would show the market before sunrise. Shopkeepers preparing their stalls would reveal how the neighbourhood wakes up.
開頭場景會是日出前的市場。攤商忙著準備，就能看出這個街區怎麼慢慢醒來。
audience
觀眾
How would you adapt a talk for an audience unfamiliar with your topic?
I would give the audience a concrete example before using specialist terms. A short question could help me check whether they were following.
我會先給觀眾一個具體例子，再用專業名詞。簡短問個問題，也能確認他們是否跟得上。
stage
舞台
What would you prepare before stepping onto a stage for the first time?
I would walk across the stage during rehearsal to learn the space. Knowing where to stand would remove one source of nerves.
彩排時，我會先走過舞台，熟悉空間。知道要站在哪裡，就少一個緊張的原因。
perform
演出
Would you rather perform something you know well or try new material?
For a first appearance, I would perform something familiar. That would let me focus on the audience instead of remembering every step.
第一次上台，我會演出熟悉的內容。這樣才能注意觀眾，不必一直想下一步。
concert
音樂會
What would make a small concert memorable even without famous performers?
A small concert could feel memorable because of the close atmosphere. Hearing performers explain a song might make the experience more personal.
小型音樂會親近的氣氛，就能讓人難忘。聽表演者分享歌曲，也會更有連結。
museum
博物館
How would you spend just one hour in a large museum?
I would choose one section of the museum rather than rush everywhere. Spending time with a few objects would leave stronger memories.
我會只挑博物館的一區，不急著全部逛完。仔細看幾件東西，反而比較記得住。
exhibition
展覽
What information would you want before deciding to visit an exhibition?
I would check what the exhibition actually includes and how long a visit takes. A sample image would help me judge my interest.
我會先看展覽實際內容和大概參觀時間。幾張示意圖片，也能幫我判斷有沒有興趣。
design
設計
How would you judge the design of an object you use every day?
I would judge the design by how easily I could use it. An attractive kettle would still disappoint me if it spilled water.
我會看設計用起來順不順手。水壺再好看，倒水一直灑出來，還是讓人失望。
pattern
圖案
How would you choose a pattern for a small room?
I would choose a simple pattern for one wall. Keeping the rest plain would stop the room from feeling too busy.
我會挑簡單的圖案，用在其中一面牆。其他地方保持素色，小房間才不會太雜。
colour
顏色
Which colour would you choose for a place where you want to feel calm?
I would choose a soft green colour for a reading corner. I would test it in daylight before painting the whole wall.
閱讀角落我會選柔和的綠色。先在日光下試試顏色，再決定要不要整面刷。
photograph
照片
What photograph would you take to show everyday life rather than a tourist landmark?
I would take a photograph of a familiar morning food stall. The waiting customers and busy cook would tell a local story.
我會拍熟悉的早餐攤照片。排隊的人和忙碌的老闆，就能說出當地生活的故事。
portrait
肖像
How could a portrait show more than someone's appearance?
A portrait could include objects connected to the person's daily work. Their surroundings might reveal interests that a formal pose would hide.
肖像可以放進和日常工作有關的物品。周圍環境，也許比正式擺姿勢更看得出興趣。
style
風格
How would you develop a personal style without simply copying someone you admire?
I would notice which parts of their style appeal to me. Then I would combine those ideas with choices that fit my own life.
我會先想，自己喜歡對方風格的哪些部分。再把想法和適合自己生活的選擇結合。
inspire
啟發
What kind of creative work could inspire you to make something yourself?
A handmade travel journal could inspire me to record my own walks. Seeing imperfect sketches would make starting feel less intimidating.
手作旅行筆記，能啟發我記錄自己的散步。看到不完美的速寫，也比較敢開始動手。
original
原作
Would seeing an original painting matter if you had already seen a good reproduction?
Seeing the original would let me notice its scale and surface. Those physical details could change how I understood the image.
看原作，才能感受實際大小和表面質地。這些實體細節，可能改變我對畫面的理解。
